metadata.purpose: Curated NASA Earth science catalogue for ML notebooks

auth_guide.note: Free account required for all NASA EarthData downloads
auth_guide.s3_note: S3 direct access requires s3credentials endpoint call (auto-handled by earthaccess.open())
auth_guide.token_note: earthaccess.login() returns an Auth object; bearer tokens auto-refreshed

how_to_fetch.python_example:
import earthaccess, xarray as xr

# 1. Login
earthaccess.login(strategy="environment")

# 2. Search (CMR under the hood)
results = earthaccess.search_data(
    short_name="GPM_3IMERGDF",
    temporal=("2023-06-01", "2023-06-30"),
    bounding_box=(-120, 25, -65, 50),  # CONUS: west, south, east, north
    count=10
)
print(f"Found {len(results)} granules")

# 3a. Stream (best for cloud, no local storage)
files = earthaccess.open(results)
ds = xr.open_mfdataset(files, group="Grid", engine="h5netcdf")

# 3b. Download subset
earthaccess.download(results[:2], "./tmp/")

# 4. Raw CMR query (no login needed for metadata)
import urllib.request, json
url = "https://cmr.earthdata.nasa.gov/search/collections.json?short_name=GPM_3IMERGDF&page_size=1"
with urllib.request.urlopen(url) as r:
    data = json.loads(r.read())
    print(data["feed"]["entry"][0]["id"])

spatial_helpers.opendap_subset_note: Append .nc4?variable[time][lat][lon] to OPeNDAP URL for server-side subsetting

temporal_alignment.compositing_note: MODIS uses maximum NDVI composite within window — clouds are suppressed but phenology may be biased
temporal_alignment.alignment_code: ds.resample(time='1D').mean()  # or pd.merge_asof() for irregular timestamps

cloud_masking.MODIS: Use StateQA or QA_60 bit flags; bits 0-1 for cloud state

leakage_prevention.spatial: Use geographically separated folds (k-fold on grid tiles, not random pixels)
leakage_prevention.temporal: Always train on past, validate/test on future dates

Feature stack: NDVI, LST, precip, wind (MERRA-2), slope (SRTM)
SAR backscatter change detection; DEM for terrain routing
SST anomaly from climatology; CHL as productivity stress proxy
Classification or regression on ice fraction; temporal sequence for LSTM
Correlate NTL growth with population density changes
Time-series InSAR; apply atmospheric correction; mask water
